question: Does a long-only, LARGE-CAP, high operating-profitability portfolio beat the value-weighted US market over 6- and 12-month holding windows, and did that survive publication? This is the translation question our 0-5 name long-only books face; the original evidence is long-short and broadly diversified.
whyThisPath: Profitability is the one academic path with E1 support (Novy-Marx 2013; Fama-French 2015 RMW; QMJ profitability) that our local studies did not settle: the repository's quality sleeve (roe, margins, leverage) measured pooled 126D rank IC -0.022 (p 0.08) with KR/US sign instability (four-factor attribution audit, v2.21).

Local stock-level replication is blocked: US history is survivorship-biased (212 of 324 departed S&P 500 names unpriced), KR historical stock research is GOVERNANCE_CLOSED (kr-alpha-atlas Phase C/D) and KR stock cash economics are SOURCE_BLOCKED (#332).

The Ken French Data Library portfolios are survivorship-free (CRSP), use lagged accounting (June formation on the fiscal year ending in t-1) and are public; they answer the translation question without our blocked data.

data.source: Ken French Data Library (Tuck), downloaded once, SHA-256 frozen
data.series: value-weighted monthly returns; market = Mkt-RF + RF from FF3

primary.portfolio: ME_OP_25 value-weighted 'ME5 OP5' (largest size quintile, highest operating-profitability quintile)

secondaryDescriptive.BIG_VALUE: ME_BM_25 'ME5 BM5' (maps to our value sleeve, already locally tested)
secondaryDescriptive.BIG_WINNERS: ME_PRIOR_25 'ME5 PRIOR5' (maps to our momentum sleeve, already locally tested; monthly reformation, high turnover)

statistics: annualised mean of monthly excess over the market (x12) and Newey-West HAC t with 12 lags
overlapping 6- and 12-month excess: share positive, 5th percentile, worst
maximum drawdown of relative wealth (portfolio / market)

costs.basis: French portfolios are gross; no turnover is published. Two flat annual drags are reported beside gross: 0.5%/yr and 1.0%/yr for annually re-formed sorts (OP, BM) and 2.0%/yr for monthly re-formed momentum. These are conservative stress assumptions, not measurements.

decisionRule.TRANSFER_SUPPORTED: post-publication HAC t >= 2.0 AND 12-month excess positive in more than half of windows AND mean excess after the 0.5%/yr drag > 0
decisionRule.multiplicity: 4 portfolios; a 'significant' statement needs HAC |t| >= 2.5 (Bonferroni 0.05/4, two-sided normal approx); Novy-Marx (2015) warns combined signals inflate t-statistics, so no combination is tested
decisionRule.gradeEffect: Whatever the verdict, profitability stays E1 in our grade matrix: external portfolios are not our data, our universe or a 0-5 name book. The verdict decides only whether a local E2 attempt is worth a licensed data source.

notClaimed: anything about a 0-5 stock book's variance
a forecast for the next 6-12 months
